title: UPSC NDA & NDA II Recruitment 2026 Exam Admit Card 394 Post
postName: National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026
vacancyDetails: Army 208, Navy 42, Air Force 120 and Naval Academy 24 posts.
qualification: Army Wing: 10+2 pass or appearing from a recognized board. Air Force and Naval Wings: 10+2 pass or appearing with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
ageLimit: Date of birth must be between 01 January 2008 and 01 January 2011, both dates inclusive, as per UPSC NDA-II rules.
applicationFee: General/OBC: Rs.100. SC/ST and all female candidates: Rs.0.
selectionProcess: Written Examination → SSB Interview → Document Verification → Medical Examination.
documentsRequired: Registration number, password or date of birth, photo ID and printed admit card

1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in/
2. Open the NDA and NA Examination (II), 2026 admit card link
3. Sign in through the candidate portal

shortDescription: UPSC NDA and NDA II Recruitment 2026 admit card is available from 03 September 2026 for 394 posts. The written examination is scheduled for 13 September 2026.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026 Admit Card for 394 posts.

The application window was open from 20 May 2026 to 11 June 2026. The admit card is available from 03 September 2026 and the written examination will be held on 13 September 2026. Download it through the official UPSC Online candidate portal and verify the centre, reporting time and instructions.

Eligibility and fee

  • Army Wing: 10+2 passed or appearing from a recognized board
  • Air Force and Naval Wings: 10+2 passed or appearing with Physics and Mathematics
  • General / OBC / EWS fee: Rs. 100
  • SC / ST fee: Nil

Vacancy details

  • Army: 208
  • Navy: 42
  • Air Force: 120
  • Naval Academy: 24
  • Total: 394 posts

Candidates should complete UPSC One Time Registration where required and carry the printed admit card and valid photo ID to the examination centre.
